editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the New Relic Verified Foundation exam by New Relic. Master observability fundamentals, platform UI, data, and monitoring.
editorial.overview: The New Relic Verified Foundation exam evaluates your knowledge of observability fundamentals, platform UI capabilities, data configuration, performance monitoring, and full stack practices. Certified by New Relic, this online unproctored multiple-choice exam is free to take and validates core telemetry and monitoring skills across various environments over a duration of 45 minutes.
editorial.who_should_take: Engineers, developers, and administrators who use New Relic to monitor applications, infrastructure, and user experiences. Suitable for practitioners looking to validate their platform knowledge and telemetry configuration skills.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official New Relic documentation and tutorials covering telemetry data types, monitoring agents, and NRQL queries to prepare carefully. Practice installing monitoring agents, configuring dashboards, setting up alerts, and analyzing transaction traces directly in the platform UI before taking the assessment to ensure complete success.

domain_guidance.summary: Covers modern web architecture trends and tools, differences between monitoring and observability, core telemetry data types, and monitoring agents in New Relic to build a strong operational base.

Focuses extensively on identifying reporting entities, viewing the overall environment status, and using diverse platform capabilities including APM, Browser, NRQL, alerts, logs, traces, hosts, and mobile to monitor system health effectively.

This domain comprehensively covers instrumentation concepts, stack layer configuration, custom data and attributes, entity and workload management, tags, and synthetics configuration to ensure complete data collection across your entire system ecosystem.

Explores data visualization using APM, errors, logs, NRQL, and Synthetics, transaction trace analysis, root cause analysis, and issue triage to help practitioners diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks quickly.
study_focus: Visualize data with APM and logs

domain_guidance.summary: This domain addresses multi-service management using filtering and tagging, alert and workflow configuration, event type NRQL queries, and core alerting concepts to maintain dependable visibility across complex distributed system architectures.
study_focus: Manage services with filtering and tagging

editorial.exam_day_guidance: You have 45 minutes to complete the online unproctored multiple-choice exam. Ensure your testing environment is quiet and free of interruptions before starting your session.

faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The New Relic Verified Foundation exam is entirely free to take. It is an online unproctored multiple-choice assessment hosted directly on learn.newrelic.com for registered users.
The exam has a strict duration of 45 minutes. You must complete all online unproctored multiple-choice questions within this allocated time limit to successfully finish the test.

faq.question_title: How long is the certification valid?
faq.answer_text: The New Relic certification remains valid for 2 years per the official University Terms. Check with New Relic for the current certification path and renewal details.

faq.question_title: What topics are covered on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The exam covers 5 distinct domains including observability fundamentals, platform UI capabilities, configuring data, performance monitoring, and full stack observability practices to test your knowledge.

methodology.summary: This overview was built using the official New Relic exam guides, documentation sources, and platform references to provide entirely factual guidance for candidates.
